preconditions.description: Grid dimensions n, m and number of colors k are within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= color <= k for row in grid for color in row)
preconditions.description: Every cell in the n x m grid contains a color value between 1 and k.
The number of queries q is between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= r1 <= n and 1 <= c1 <= m and 1 <= r2 <= n and 1 <= c2 <= m for r1, c1, r2, c2 in queries)
preconditions.description: All query coordinates are within the grid boundaries.

preconditions.expression: all(any(grid[r-1][c-1] == color for r in range(1, n+1) for c in range(1, m+1)) for color in range(1, k+1))
preconditions.description: Every color from 1 to k appears at least once in the grid.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly q lines, one for each query.

postconditions.expression: all(int(output_lines[i]) == min_dist(grid, queries[i][0], queries[i][1], queries[i][2], queries[i][3]) for i in range(q))
postconditions.description: Each output line i contains the minimum number of seconds to travel from the start cell to the end cell for the i-th query, where min_dist computes the shortest path distance allowing moves to adjacent cells or any cell of the same color.
